description: League of Legends streamers live right now that TrackDIFF tracks, as cards: display name, platform and channel, stream title, viewer count, the champion they are playing (`liveChampionId`), their best account's rank, primary role, region and top champions. Filter by champion, role, tier or region; 24 cards per page. Empty rows mean nobody matching is live. For one streamer's full page call `get_persona`.

champion.description: Only streamers currently playing this champion ("Jinx", "lee-sin").

region.description: Only streamers whose main account is on this platform ("na", "kr", …).

tier.description: Only streamers whose best account is this tier, e.g. "CHALLENGER".

name: list_live_streamers
title: Live League streamers
